verdict.rationale: First-party docs say datasets can be built from historical production traces, and that real traces can be added to a dataset so a failure becomes a repeatable test. Offline evaluation is documented as running the app on a dataset to create an experiment, with configurable repetitions, concurrency and caching, and with human, code, LLM-as-judge and pairwise evaluators for comparing versions and catching regressions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the trace-to-dataset curation and offline experiment workflow.
